capabilities: Copy Bible verse text from Markdown Bible files in the vault
Insert Obsidian links to multiple Bible verses from one input like "Gen 1,1-3"
Support multiple Bible translations kept in separate folders
Choose between standard, embedded, or invisible links
Adjust verse offset and heading level settings when linking goes wrong
extras: The copy command requires Bible files already in the vault as Markdown (one file per chapter, verses marked with headings); links spanning more than one chapter are not supported. Multi-translation support is off by default.
problem: Linking multiple Bible verses in Obsidian requires manual entry of individual links, and there is no built-in way to pull verse text from Markdown Bible files.

relations.evidence: Compatible with the Bible Study Kit.

summary: Bible verse tool that copies verse text from your own Markdown Bible files and inserts Obsidian links for multiple verses at once.
